svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 OTA 包保存、分配、状态通知与 MQTT 分块下载

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 OTA 包保存、分配、状态通知与 MQTT 分块下载
Phase A: package metadata and binary
Metadata and binary are separate transactions.
The upload, hash and JPA entity all materialize the full byte array.
Phase B: Device or Profile assignment
[queued target is stale or Device removed]
INITIATED callback may run before or after Queue commit
Only synchronous process() exceptions are caught and logged.
Async Telemetry/Attribute failures happen outside this catch and do not retry the Queue record.
Generic device telemetry has no server-side transition validator.
LwM2M uses a separate Object 5/9 state machine.
Pointer DB, Queue, target/state telemetry, Shared Attributes,
Actor delivery, binary chunks and final device result do not share a transaction.
